nodes.title: External comment change detected
nodes.description: The open review's comment file changes or is deleted outside the app.

nodes.title: Does the external update conflict with the comment being edited?
nodes.description: Workspace compares the currently edited comment with the external document; unrelated changes and unchanged comments do not create a conflict.

nodes.title: Apply external comment changes
nodes.description: With no local edit, apply the latest comment content to the canvas.

nodes.title: Show conflict options
nodes.description: If the comment being edited changed, offer the external version or local draft; if it was deleted, offer to discard or restore the local draft.

nodes.title: Continue the review with the chosen content
nodes.description: Apply the resolution: use the external text or keep the local draft after a change; discard or restore the draft after deletion, then continue the review.
